name: Saint Elenda
description: Saint Elenda is the first vampire and a living saint of the Church of Dusk, a former guardian of the Immortal Sun on Ixalan.

bio.text: She routed the apostate princes' army outside Alta Torrezon and gave vampirism to the loyalist nobility through the Rite of Redemption.

bio.text: After the Immortal Sun was stolen she searched for it for centuries, and she found it in deserted Orazca and placed herself in an enchanted sleep to guard it.

citations.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

bio.text: Awakened, she emerged from a tomb near Orazca, lamented that the Church had turned her ritual into invasion, and refused to help the Legion recover the vanished Sun.

bio.text: Later she met Caztaca and Beckett Brass at Sen Gael, warned that Vito's expedition could bring Aclazotz to Torrezon, and signed a contract recognizing Brass's coalition if she stopped it.

timeline.summary: At a tomb near Orazca they find Saint Elenda; Angrath strikes Huatli and goes on alone, and she sends a Dinosaur to trample him.
timeline.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As defeat seems certain, Elenda charges into the apostate princes' guard and routs their army.
timeline.quote: Just as defeat seemed certain, a stranger emerged: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loyalist nobility partake of Elenda's gift of vampirism, the Rite of Redemption.
timeline.quote: With the church's blessing, loyalist nobility partook of Elenda's gift.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "First expedition to Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein tells Manuel the legend of Saint Elenda, the nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire.
timeline.quote: She was born mortal, a warrior nun charged with her brothers and sisters of faith to guard the Immortal Sun in the mountains of Torrezon.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: In the telling, Pedron the Wicked kills the guardians of the Immortal Sun and a winged beast steals the Sun from him.
timeline.quote: Pedron the Wicked killed them all.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona volunteers to lead the first ship in Queen Miralda's fleet searching for Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: Vona had volunteered to lead the first ship that left port.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges.
timeline.quote: a pale white hand reached out from the interior.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath identifies the vampire as Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: You are Saint Elenda,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
timeline.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli threatens Elenda, refusing to let the Legion of Dusk take the city.
timeline.quote: I refuse to allow the Legion of Dusk to take the city.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda says she came only to retrieve what was hers and leave the rest in peace.
timeline.quote: To retrieve the one thing that is ours,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda laments that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
timeline.quote: I left the Church with the knowledge of the ritual to take on my burden

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda arrives and asks whether the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda accepts the Sun is gone for good and tells her followers they are free.
timeline.quote: No, my child. We are free. It is gone forever.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda reveals she ended her journey centuries ago upon finding Orazca.
timeline.quote: My journey ended centuries ago, when I found this place.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona says they conquered Torrezon and built an empire in Elenda's honor.
timeline.quote: We conquered Torrezon,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli urges Elenda to return home and tell her own story.
timeline.quote: You must be the one to tell your story. Not them.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: Take me to Queen Miralda,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein slices Vona's cheek for insulting Elenda.
timeline.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda forces Vona to the floor with a magical command.
timeline.quote: Elenda snapped her fingers angrily and Vona's knees buckled

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: The three vampires leave into the night.
timeline.quote: the three vampires exited into the night.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona refuses to return to Torrezon empty-handed (non-canon Legion of Dusk ending).
timeline.quote: I will not return to Torrezon empty-handed,

citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda tells Vona to claim Orazca and sails east.
timeline.quote: Claim Orazca for your own. I will sail to the East.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: In 495 BD a stranger wreathed in black vapor routs the apostasine princes' army outside Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda gives the gift of vampirism to Alta Torrezon's loyalist nobility, founding the Rite of Redemption.
timeline.quote: This ritualistic blessing of the chosen with vampirism became known as the Rite of Redemption.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda tells her followers that immortality was not the purpose of her gift but protection, and that she will be sentinel of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Elenda answered that immortality was not the purpose of her gift, but protection.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein punishes Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.
timeline.quote: Vona denied her, but Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda's centuries-long search ends.
timeline.quote: Her centuries-long search is ended.

citation.text: Elenda, the Dusk Rose (Double Masters 2022, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elenda becomes a vampire after the Immortal Sun is stolen and teaches her Rite to the nobles; Mavren Fein is an early convert.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda reappears and tells her followers they are free from their ancient duty; Mavren punishes Vona for speaking ill of her, and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli serves as Caztaca's scribe at a meeting with Elenda and Beckett Brass, convinces them to accept a deal and seals the treaty.
timeline.quote: In the end, Saheeli convinced the other two leaders to accept the deal.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A guard reports that Elenda herself is among the arriving party.
timeline.quote: Elenda is with them.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda enters, glowing with a halo, and sits with Caztaca.
timeline.quote: The Venerable swept her hood back as she entered the cabin, uncovering her face and revealing a soft, steadily glowing diadem that crowned her head.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca lays out her concern that the emperor will lead the Sun Empire into another war.
timeline.quote: Our emperor will lead us to war

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda tells of schism in the Church of Dusk and a second expedition to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Pontifex Fein struggles to hold the Church of Dusk together.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda reveals the second expedition is led by Vito, a hierophant of the Antifex, and could bring Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: This group is led by Vito Quijano de Pasamonte, one of the Antifex's hierophants

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda warns that if Aclazotz sets claw on Torrezon the realm will tear itself apart.
timeline.quote: If Aclazotz sets one claw on Torrezon, the realm will tear itself apart

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass bursts in with armed pirates and takes control of the meeting.
timeline.quote: You came here on my ship, to haggle over nations on my island

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass demands that her coalition be recognized as a player on equal terms.
timeline.quote: my coalition demands recognition as a player of this game on equal terms.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass threatens to kill both leaders and blockade the seas if refused.
timeline.quote: Then I'll kill the two of you here and the stink of cannon smoke will choke Torrezon and Ixalan

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli urges the leaders to accept Brass's demand.
timeline.quote: Accept her demand

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass states the coalition's naval strength.
timeline.quote: We have six hundred fighting ships stocked and seaworthy, all veteran crews

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda promises letters of marque and recognition of the coalition if Brass stops Vito's expedition.
timeline.quote: We will write you letters of marque

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The three leaders sign the contract Saheeli transcribed.
timeline.quote: One by one the three leaders signed, sealing their contract.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli seals the document in a metal cylinder that only she can open.
timeline.quote: Saheeli spun a fine, copper, silver, and gold container around the document.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass and Elenda depart, each toasting a new world.
timeline.quote: Pleasure doing business with you two.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda discovers the Immortal Sun in deserted Orazca and places herself in an enchanted sleep to guard it.
timeline.quote: Elenda placed herself in an enchanted sleep within a tomb of the bat- god Aclazotz

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches Orazca's gates and awakens the city and Elenda.
timeline.quote: There, he used his magic to awaken Orazca and the elder dinosaurs entombed within it.

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli, resolved to remind her people of their purpose.
timeline.quote: She first encountered the planeswalkers Angrath and Huatli

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes through Tezzeret's portal; Elenda refuses to help the Legion recover it.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused to aid the Legion in recovering it, declaring their ancient burden fulfilled at last.

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun's removal shatters Ixalan's planar seal; the Legion retreats, the Coalition scatters and the Sun Empire reclaims Orazca.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire, led by Apatzec Intli III , reclaimed Orazca

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
